notes: Calavo Growers, Inc. (NASDAQ: CVGW) — California-based avocado processor + grower (CIK 1133470). Two segments: Grown (fresh avocados sourced from Mexico/Peru/California growers, including ~10,000 acres of company/affiliated avocado groves) and Prepared (frozen guacamole + fresh-cut produce, Salsa Lisa). Fiscal year ends Oct 31. Reports in USD. Significant restructuring 2022-23: sold Salsa Lisa (May 2023), exited fresh-cut food service. Volatile avocado pricing.

periods.notes: FY20 (ended Oct 31 2020): revenue $1.02B (-13% pandemic foodservice). EBITDA $25M. Net loss $2M.
FY21 (ended Oct 31 2021): revenue $1.14B (+12%). EBITDA collapsed to $4M (cost inflation, labor). Net loss $16M.
FY22 (ended Oct 31 2022): revenue $1.22B (+6%). Net loss $27M (foodservice impairments). Dividend cut to $0.40.
FY23 (ended Oct 31 2023): revenue $951M (-22%) post Salsa Lisa divestiture + foodservice exit. EBITDA $31M. Net loss $7M (continuing ops). Net cash positive.
FY24 (ended Oct 31 2024): revenue $670M (-30%) on continued portfolio rationalization. EBITDA $33M (margin improving). Net income $8M (returned to profit). Strong cash position.
